reading.zh: 从左到右：网关与鉴权/数据域过滤是所有外部调用的入口；主数据只读接口供 HR 等下游系统调用；合同系统集成与归档数据抽取位于系统边界的另一侧。
reading.en: Left to right: the gateway and its auth/scope filter front everything; the read-only master-data API is what downstream systems (HR) call; contract-system integration and warehouse extraction sit on the other side of the boundary.
